echo "=== spring-app logs: started/ready ==="; docker logs urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 2>&1 | grep -iE "Started UrboCmsApplication|Netty started|Tomcat started|Started .*Application" | tail -3
echo "=== what is serve proc 161930? ==="; cat /proc/161930/cmdline 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' ' '; echo
echo "=== check each serve's app via its logs ==="; for f in app cms boards; do echo "--$f (last line)--"; tail -1 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/$f.log; done
